verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only glancing support. The Privacy Portal is documented to "detect and classify customer data" as part of a privacy suite for HIPAA, GDPR and CCPA. Custom JavaScript destination Functions could plausibly be used to transform data before sending, but that is a workaround the docs never tie to PII handling. Missing for 10: documented per-destination PII blocking or filtering rules, hashing of sensitive fields, masking of attributes, field-level filtering controls, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
